verdict.rationale: Bento's docs describe OpenTelemetry span capture with a navigable span tree covering every model call, tool call, and agent step. A `session_id` kwarg is attached to every span, and a shared `convo_id` ties multiple runs together into a conversation thread. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of parent/child span nesting for multi-step runs (only implied by "span tree"), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the session/thread grouping view.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Every span from every framework, captured over OpenTelemetry. Open the span tree, or follow a signal straight to the call that broke.
Capture every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app with one line.
`init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id`, and `tags` kwargs. Bento invokes them on every span
pass the same `convo_id` on every call and Bento ties the runs together for you.
